units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:12">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>נ׳ הקדמוני</he> the original serpent (the seducer of Eve).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:2">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>נ׳ זה רשע בעל תשובות</he> that serpent is wicked and skilled in arguments.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 8a:14">Bekh. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ לשבע שנים וכ׳</he> a serpent’s pregnancy lasts seven years, and for that wicked animal I find no parallel (in the vegetable kingdom).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 54:1">Gen. R. s. 54</cite> <he>הנ׳ של בית</he> the domestic serpent (harmless); a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְחָשִׁים</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:16">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>נ׳ ועקרבים</he> snakes and scorpions; a. fr.

senses.gloss: a pungent (poisonous) fluid in the leaves or in the stems of onions kept for a long time in the ground.
a disease of the eye, v. חִלָּזוֹן.
